forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {受|う}かっていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To succeed in an examination or selection process. The intransitive counterpart of {受|う}ける, focusing on the result rather than the act of taking the test. The thing passed is marked with に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かった。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}している→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm studying every day to get into university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転|うんてん}{免許|めんきょ}→運転免許：15285_untenmenkyo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{受|う}かる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to pass the driver's license exam on the first try.

notes:
{受|う}かる is an intransitive result verb — you do not actively "do" passing; rather, the result of passing happens to you. This contrasts with ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧, which describes the action of taking a test.

USAGE:
- The exam or institution passed is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる, ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる
- The opposite is ⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (to fail an exam)

CONTRAST WITH {受|う}ける:
- ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ means "to take" an exam (the action)
- {受|う}かる means "to pass" an exam (the result)
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ = to take an exam
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる = to pass an exam

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる — to pass an exam
- ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる — to get into university
- ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{受|う}かる — to pass an interview
- ⟦{一発|いっぱつ}→一発：08895_ippatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{受|う}かる — to pass on the first try
